scripts.build: npm run build -w @greenguard/membership-client && prisma generate && tsc
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @greenguard/membership-client && prisma generate && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/src/*.test.js dist/catalog/*.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --src dist --extension .js --exclude "**/*.test.js" --exclude "**/generated/**" --reporter lcov --reporter text node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/src/*.test.js dist/catalog/*.test.js
